EvidenceOut.description:
A link to the data a finding cites.

- operation: observations of `fingerprint_id` between `start` and `end`
- plan: plan `plan_id` of `fingerprint_id`, pointing at node `node_path`
- relation_stat: table or index sample `relation_stat_id`

`available` is false once retention has deleted what it points at.
EvidenceOut.title: EvidenceOut

FindingFact.description:
One number or value behind a finding, kept with it so it stays readable after the
underlying observations age out.
FindingFact.title: FindingFact

HistoryPoint.description: One bucket of an operation's history. The mean is None when there were no calls.
HistoryPoint.title: HistoryPoint

OperationPlan.description:
The latest generic plan for an operation, or why there isn't one.

- captured: `root` and `raw` hold the plan.
- failed: EXPLAIN was tried and `reason` says why it gave no plan.
- not_captured: plans are available but none was captured yet for this operation.
- unavailable: this source can't produce plans; `reason` and `fix` say why and what to do.
OperationPlan.title: OperationPlan

OperationSummary.description: One row of the explorer: an operation (a fingerprint) and its metrics in the window.
OperationSummary.title: OperationSummary

PlanNode.description: One node of a PostgreSQL plan, with the planner's estimates (nothing was executed).
PlanNode.title: PlanNode

SourceHealth.description: One card of the health strip: the source, its totals and its trend.
SourceHealth.title: SourceHealth

TrendPoint.description: Activity in one minute: total calls and total execution time across all statements.
TrendPoint.title: TrendPoint

post.description:
Public: sign in as the read-only demo user without a password ("Try the demo").

Safe because the demo user can't change anything (every write returns 403) and the
endpoint only works when the operator enabled the demo with QP_DEMO_ENABLED.

429.description: Too many failed sign-ins from this client; retry later

patch.description:
Dismiss, resolve or reopen a finding.

A dismissed finding stays dismissed however often its rule fires again. A resolved one
reopens if the problem shows up in evidence collected after it was resolved.

get.description:
One stored plan by id, exactly as captured.

Plans are immutable evidence: a finding cites the plan it was based on, and this returns
that plan even after a newer one has been captured for the same operation.
The rule catalogue: what each rule checks, its evidence and its thresholds.

post.description: Save a source, but only after a successful connection test.

400.description: The connection test failed; nothing was saved

post.description:
Try the connection and report capabilities without saving anything.

A failed connection is a normal result (`ok: false` with an error code and message),
not an HTTP error.

400.description: A stored password can't be reused for a different server

put.description:
Replace a source's settings.

Changing how to connect (engine, host, port, database, username, TLS, password) requires a
passing connection test. Changing only the name, description or `enabled` doesn't, so a
source whose database is down can still be renamed or disabled.

400.description: The connection test failed; nothing was saved

post.description:
Re-run the connection and capability checks with the stored settings.

Always returns the source; a failed check shows as `status: failing` with `last_error`.

get.description: Calls and execution time per minute for one source.
The health strip: every source with its status and recent activity.
